description: This file defines a static helper class 'OptionHelper' for creating and validating command-line options using System.CommandLine library.

classes.name: OptionHelper
classes.description: A static class providing utility methods for creating command-line options with validation.

methods.name: CreateOption
methods.description: Creates a command-line option with optional default value and validator.

methods.name: Validator
methods.description: Validates the value of an option result using a provided predicate.

methods.name: OnlyStrictlyPositive
methods.description: Checks if an integer is strictly positive (> 0).

methods.name: OnlyPositiveOrZero
methods.description: Checks if an integer is positive or zero (>= 0).
